description: Single source of truth for the cross-platform two-finger pinch PATH geometry (issue #12996). A rotating pinch follows an arc, not the straight start-to-end chord, so a pure rotation (distanceStart == distanceEnd) never zooms. Each row is (centerX, centerY, distanceStart, distanceEnd, rotationDegrees, fraction) and the expected UNORDERED pair of finger positions [x, y] after that fraction (0..1) of the gesture: the axis angle is rotationDegrees * fraction and the radius is linearly interpolated from distanceStart / 2 to distanceEnd / 2. The Android PinchGeometryTest.kt and iOS PinchGeometryTests.swift inline path tables are verified against this file by test/parity/pinchGoldenVectorParity.test.ts.
